title: 第15章 冯家起势第16章 果然被退婚了
content_zh:
接下来的半年多，叶非凡似乎受到了上次灵宝阁事情的影响，倒是没有怎么外出游荡了，似乎放弃了寻找外挂捡漏的想法，一心一意的扑在修炼上，但奈何资质实在是过于普通，即便有微型聚灵阵和固灵佩的相助，仍然没有突破到练气6重。
“唉，原本想着靠着大哥给的灵石和固灵佩修炼，能够一举突破到练气6重的，看来还是太过于艰难了，我的资质真的这么差么，虽然不能说是废物，但也好不了多少啊。”
看着眼前最后的3颗灵石化为粉末，叶非凡叹了口气。
微型聚灵阵的短期内也不太能用的上了，除非能够在获取到一些灵石，但从已有的情况来看不太可能了，父亲那边花了300灵石给自己买了固灵佩，这其中还有不少灵石是找家主那边借的，短时间内肯定是无法从父母那边要到灵石，至于大哥二哥那边，也拉不下脸再去要，毕竟已经帮助自己很多了，叶非凡也不是那种得寸进尺的人。
“好在离练气6重应该不远了，用固灵佩的话，再修炼修炼，就能突破了。”
“轻盈术好像练的也差不多了，基本能用，还是再去选一门术法练吧，得亏是叶家嫡系子弟，在术法上倒是没有什么大的限制，能多学几个，虽然都是垃圾，但总比没有技能好。”
叶非凡收拾好微型聚灵阵后，一下子没有了修炼的心情，便打算再去学门术法。
叶家里面，对于嫡系子弟学习低级的武技或者术法倒是没有什么限制，也不需要什么贡献，随便学，这点很符合当下叶非凡的情况，他可以多挑选一些术法学习，俗话说艺多不压身，也许有一刻能够救命。
至于非嫡系子弟，还是需要一些家庭贡献才能选择学习武技或者术法的，因此非嫡系子弟在前期并不会去过多的学习低级的武技或者术法，而是选择攒一波贡献，然后在达到一定的修为后，选择一门较为强力的术法主修，这也是之前家族检测上，大家使用的武技或者术法类型都很少的原因。
前往家族藏书阁后，叶非凡简单看了下，就决定修炼灵气盾。
一是因为他现在的修为较为低下，能够学习的术法种类很少，二是他现在确实缺一个防御类的术法。
攻击有‘飞火弹’，强力刮痧，天下无双。
移动有‘轻盈术’，减轻负重，聊胜于无。
防御有‘灵气盾’，站着被打，多抗几下。
攻防一体，战斗力不低于5，简直恐怖如斯。
略微嘲笑了下自己当前的战斗力，便回到自己的房内院子中试着修炼灵气盾。
……
也不知道是叶非凡在修炼术法方面有天赋还是因为低级的术法实在是简单，叶非凡只花了十天的时间就能释放出一个灵气盾在面前。
“虽然释放的速度还比较慢，这个盾的面积大小也不太可靠，但至少还是成功了，只要后续再多多练习，应该很快就能熟练掌握了吧，看来我在这方面有点天赋？不错不错。”
看着自己面前的灵气盾，叶非凡非常满意，遂决定给自己放个假，准备出去晃悠晃悠，天天在这里修炼实在是太无聊了，尤其是升级速度非常慢的情况下。

虽然叶非凡口头上一直说着要开摆，但目前，在有微型聚灵阵和固灵佩甚至之前有聚气丹的情况下，他还是很努力的在修炼，并没有实际上的开摆举动，但随着微型聚灵阵的暂时下线，只有固灵佩的他积极性的确降低了不少。
老规矩，还是去东城集市那边逛逛，不求找到什么破损宝物，只是想着放松放松，至于为什么只逛东城集市这边，那原因也很明显，当然是修为太低，在其他区域很有被锤的风险，叶非凡很明白自己并没有受虐的倾向，在没有必要的情况下，还是苟着点好。
在东城集市中这看看，那看看的，时常能听到老板和顾客们的闲聊。
“哎，老张啊，前两天我听说说冯家冯潇一举突破到练气12重，并且还通过的天灵宗的入门考核，成为了天灵宗的正式弟子，冯家老祖特别高兴，直接将冯潇定为冯家的少家主了啊。”
“我也听说了，这天灵宗可是了不起的大宗门，冯潇能够成为正式弟子，那可大有前途啊，筑基是肯定了的，甚至有了一丝结丹的可能，就算不能结丹，凭借他天灵宗弟子和筑基的修为，以后在咱们辉月城那也是一个大人物了。”
“你说这会不会是假的啊，半年前叶家叶飞扬突破练气12重，当时大家都认为他是辉月城第一人，这才过了半年，冯家冯潇也突破到了练气12重，甚至都拜入天灵宗当正式弟子，气势上稳稳的压了叶飞扬一头，这变化也太快了。”
“这谁知道呢，消息应该也是冯家那边故意放出来的吧。”
“你们不信，我可是信的。”
“怎么回事，李叔，你还有其他内幕消息？赶紧告诉下我们几个吧。”
“哈哈哈，那倒是没有，只不过我相信冯家还不敢拿天灵宗的名头来作假，万一被天灵宗的人知道了，那不得派人过来把他们冯家给灭了，风险太大，他们受不起。”
“对哦，李叔说的有道理啊，不愧是咱李叔，这方面还是看得透。”
“哈哈哈，哪里哪里，也不过是多吃了几年的米饭罢了。”
content_en:
In the next more than half a year, Ye Feifan seemed to be affected by the last incident at Lingbao Pavilion, so he didn't go out much anymore. He seemed to have given up the idea of ​​looking for cheats and focused on training wholeheartedly. However, his qualifications were too ordinary. Even with the help of the miniature spirit gathering array and the solid soul pendant, he still had not broken through to the sixth level of Qi training.
"Well, I originally thought that I could break through to the sixth level of Qi training with the help of the spiritual stones and solid soul pendants given by my elder brother. It seems that it is still too difficult. Are my qualifications really that bad? Although I can't say that I am a waste, it is not much better."
Seeing the last three spirit stones in front of him turn into powder, Ye Feifan sighed.
The miniature spirit gathering array is unlikely to be used in the short term, unless some spirit stones can be obtained, but judging from the current situation, it is unlikely. My father spent 300 spirit stones to buy himself a solid spirit pendant, and many of the spirit stones were borrowed from the family owner. I will definitely not be able to get the spirit stones from my parents in a short time. As for the eldest brother and the second brother, they can't help themselves anymore. After all, they have already helped me a lot, and Ye Feifan is not the kind of person to push himself too far.
"Fortunately, we should not be far from the sixth level of Qi training. If we use the Guling Pendant and practice more, we will be able to break through."
"It seems that I have almost practiced the Lightness Technique. It is basically usable. Let's choose another technique to practice. Thanks to being a direct descendant of the Ye family, there are no big restrictions on the techniques. I can learn a few more. Although they are all rubbish, they are better than no skills at all."
After Ye Feifan packed up the miniature spirit gathering array, he suddenly lost the mood to practice and planned to learn another technique.
In the Ye family, there are no restrictions on direct descendants learning low-level martial arts or techniques, and there is no need for any contribution. They can learn at will. This is very suitable for Ye Feifan's current situation. He can choose more techniques to learn. As the saying goes, if you have too many skills, you may be able to save your life for a moment.
As for non-direct descendants, they still need some family contribution before they can choose to learn martial arts or techniques. Therefore, non-direct descendants will not learn too many low-level martial arts or techniques in the early stage. Instead, they will choose to save a wave of contributions, and then after reaching a certain level of cultivation, they will choose a more powerful technique to major in. This is also the reason why in the previous family test, everyone used very few martial arts or techniques.
After going to the family library, Ye Feifan took a brief look and decided to practice aura shield.
One is because his current cultivation level is relatively low and there are very few types of spells that he can learn. The other is that he really lacks a defensive spell now.
The attack includes 'flying fire bombs' and powerful scraping, which is unparalleled in the world.
There is a ‘Lightness Technique’ in moving, reducing the weight is better than nothing.
The defense has a 'spiritual shield'. If you are hit while standing, resist a few more times.
Attack and defense are integrated, and the combat power is not less than 5, which is simply terrifying.
After slightly laughing at his current combat power, he returned to his room and courtyard to try to cultivate the spiritual energy shield.
…
I don’t know whether Ye Fanfan is talented in practicing magic or because the low-level magic is really simple. It only took Ye Fanfan ten days to release a spiritual shield in front of him.
"Although the release speed is still relatively slow, and the area of ​​the shield is not reliable, at least it is successful. As long as you practice more in the future, you should be able to master it quickly. It seems that I have some talent in this area? Not bad, not bad."
Looking at the spiritual energy shield in front of him, Ye Feifan was very satisfied, so he decided to give himself a holiday and prepare to go out and wander around. It was too boring to practice here every day, especially when the upgrade speed was very slow.
Although Ye Feifan has been saying verbally that he wants to show off, at present, with the mini-spirit gathering array and the Guling Pendant and even the Qi-gathering Pill before, he is still practicing very hard and has not actually made any moves, but with the micro-gatheringWith the spiritual formation temporarily offline, Gu Lingpei's enthusiasm has indeed dropped a lot.
The old rule is to go shopping in the Dongcheng Market. You don't want to find any damaged treasures, but just want to relax. As for why you only visit the Dongcheng Market, the reason is also obvious. Of course, your cultivation level is too low, and there is a high risk of being hammered in other areas. Ye Feifan understands that he does not have a tendency to be abused. It is better to be patient unless necessary.
Looking here and there in the Dongcheng Market, you can often hear the bosses and customers chatting.
"Hey, Lao Zhang, I heard two days ago that Feng Xiao of the Feng family broke through to the 12th level of Qi training, and also passed the entrance examination of the Tianling Sect and became an official disciple of the Tianling Sect. The ancestor of the Feng family was very happy and directly designated Feng Xiao as the young head of the Feng family."
"I've also heard that Tianling Sect is a great sect. If Feng Xiao can become an official disciple, he has a great future. Foundation building is certain, and there is even a possibility of forming a pill. Even if he cannot form a pill, with his cultivation as a disciple of Tianling Sect and Foundation building, he will be a big shot in our Huiyue City in the future."
"Do you think this is fake? Half a year ago, Ye Feiyang of the Ye family broke through to the 12th level of Qi training. At that time, everyone thought he was the number one person in Huiyue City. Only half a year later, Feng Xiao of the Feng family also broke through to the 12th level of Qi training. He even became a formal disciple of the Tianling Sect. In terms of momentum, he has steadily surpassed Ye Feiyang. This change is too fast."
"Who knows? The news should have been deliberately released by the Feng family."
"You don't believe it, but I do."
"What's going on, Uncle Li, do you have other inside information? Tell us quickly."
"Hahaha, that's not true, but I believe that the Feng family doesn't dare to use the name of Tianling Sect to lie. If the people of Tianling Sect find out, then they must not send people over to destroy the Feng family. The risk is too great and they can't afford it."
"Yes, what Uncle Li said makes sense. As expected of us, Uncle Li can still see through this aspect."
"Hahaha, no matter what, it's just a few more years of rice."
